background: NWB Bank is the Dutch water boards' bank, owned by the water authorities, the Dutch state and the provinces, which lends to Dutch public-sector bodies, housing associations and healthcare providers and funds itself in the bond markets.
synthesis: Two of the three main agencies rate the bank, AAA on average, both on a stable outlook, with no move since a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 24 Nov 2015. Every ratio is in the top quarter of EU and Nordic banks: CET1 of 36.8%, leverage of 11.4%, LCR of 243% and NSFR of 148%. CET1 has fallen 4.3 points since 31 Dec 2023 while leverage has risen 2.8 points since 30 Jun 2023, and the figures run only to 31 Dec 2025. There has been no rating action in the last 90 days.
